You translate a traveller's one-day trip request in Singapore into a Python program that uses the z3
solver (`import z3`) to find a schedule satisfying EVERY requirement, or prove that none exists.

Facts (times in minutes since midnight, e.g. 09:00 = 540; money in whole SGD):
Places (id | name | cost | typical duration | open-close | showtimes):
skyhelix | SkyHelix Sentosa | 20 | 30 | 10:00-21:30 | -
national_museum | National Museum of Singapore | 15 | 120 | 10:00-19:00 | -
chinatown_complex | Chinatown Complex Food Centre | 8 | 45 | 07:00-22:00 | -
buddha_tooth | Buddha Tooth Relic Temple | 0 | 45 | 07:00-17:00 | -
botanic_gardens | Singapore Botanic Gardens | 0 | 120 | 05:00-24:00 | -
artscience | ArtScience Museum | 30 | 90 | 10:00-19:00 | -
bird_paradise | Bird Paradise | 49 | 180 | 09:00-18:00 | -
skypark | Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck | 32 | 60 | 11:00-21:00 | -
spectra | Spectra Light and Water Show | 0 | 15 | 19:45-21:30 | 20:00, 21:00
peranakan_museum | Peranakan Museum | 15 | 90 | 10:00-19:00 | -
clarke_quay | Clarke Quay | 30 | 90 | 17:00-24:00 | -
Travel times in minutes between places (row -> column):
skyhelix: national_museum 24, chinatown_complex 20, buddha_tooth 20, botanic_gardens 26, artscience 24, bird_paradise 51, skypark 24, spectra 23, peranakan_museum 24, clarke_quay 22

chinatown_complex: skyhelix 20, national_museum 15, buddha_tooth 11, botanic_gardens 22, artscience 15, bird_paradise 47, skypark 15, spectra 15, peranakan_museum 14, clarke_quay 13
buddha_tooth: skyhelix 20, national_museum 15, chinatown_complex 11, botanic_gardens 22, artscience 15, bird_paradise 47, skypark 15, spectra 14, peranakan_museum 14, clarke_quay 13
botanic_gardens: skyhelix 26, national_museum 20, chinatown_complex 22, buddha_tooth 22, artscience 24, bird_paradise 36, skypark 25, spectra 25, peranakan_museum 21, clarke_quay 21
artscience: skyhelix 24, national_museum 14, chinatown_complex 15, buddha_tooth 15, botanic_gardens 24, bird_paradise 48, skypark 11, spectra 11, peranakan_museum 14, clarke_quay 14
bird_paradise: skyhelix 51, national_museum 44, chinatown_complex 47, buddha_tooth 47, botanic_gardens 36, artscience 48, skypark 49, spectra 48, peranakan_museum 44, clarke_quay 45
skypark: skyhelix 24, national_museum 15, chinatown_complex 15, buddha_tooth 15, botanic_gardens 25, artscience 11, bird_paradise 49, spectra 11, peranakan_museum 15, clarke_quay 15
spectra: skyhelix 23, national_museum 15, chinatown_complex 15, buddha_tooth 14, botanic_gardens 25, artscience 11, bird_paradise 48, skypark 11, peranakan_museum 14, clarke_quay 14
peranakan_museum: skyhelix 24, national_museum 11, chinatown_complex 14, buddha_tooth 14, botanic_gardens 21, artscience 14, bird_paradise 44, skypark 15, spectra 14, clarke_quay 12
clarke_quay: skyhelix 22, national_museum 12, chinatown_complex 13, buddha_tooth 13, botanic_gardens 21, artscience 14, bird_paradise 45, skypark 15, spectra 14, peranakan_museum 12

Rules of the domain: a visit lasts exactly its duration (the typical one unless the traveller gives one); it must
lie within opening hours; a show may only start at one of its showtimes; visits cannot overlap and consecutive
visits need the travel time between them; must-visit places are required, optional ones may be skipped;
budget is the sum of costs of visited places.

Contract: output ONE python code block. When run, the program must print exactly one final line:
either the word UNSAT, or a JSON list of objects {"location_id": id, "start": minutes, "end": minutes}
for the visited places. Do not read input, do not use the network, do not print anything after that line.

Example of the output format only: [{"location_id": "museum", "start": 540, "end": 660}]

I have 8 hours and 10 minutes starting at 11:00. I'm starting from Clarke Quay. My budget is S$83. I definitely need to see Singapore Botanic Gardens, ArtScience Museum and Bird Paradise. Optionally, SkyHelix Sentosa, National Museum of Singapore, Chinatown Complex Food Centre, Buddha Tooth Relic Temple, Marina Bay Sands SkyPark Observation Deck, Spectra Light and Water Show and Peranakan Museum.

response:
```python
import json
from z3 import *

# Place data
places = {
    "skyhelix": {"cost": 20, "dur": 30, "open": 600, "close": 1290, "shows": []},
    "national_museum": {"cost": 15, "dur": 120, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
    "chinatown_complex": {"cost": 8, "dur": 45, "open": 420, "close": 1320, "shows": []},
    "buddha_tooth": {"cost": 0, "dur": 45, "open": 420, "close": 1020, "shows": []},
    "botanic_gardens": {"cost": 0, "dur": 120, "open": 300, "close": 1440, "shows": []},
    "artscience": {"cost": 30, "dur": 90, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
    "bird_paradise": {"cost": 49, "dur": 180, "open": 540, "close": 1080, "shows": []},
    "skypark": {"cost": 32, "dur": 60, "open": 660, "close": 1260, "shows": []},
    "spectra": {"cost": 0, "dur": 15, "open": 1185, "close": 1290, "shows": [1200, 1260]},
    "peranakan_museum": {"cost": 15, "dur": 90, "open": 600, "close": 1140, "shows": []},
    "clarke_quay": {"cost": 30, "dur": 90, "open": 1020, "close": 1440, "shows": []}
}

travel_times = {
    "skyhelix": {"national_museum": 24, "chinatown_complex": 20, "buddha_tooth": 20, "botanic_gardens": 26, "artscience": 24, "bird_paradise": 51, "skypark": 24, "spectra": 23, "peranakan_museum": 24, "clarke_quay": 22, "skyhelix": 0},
    "national_museum": {"skyhelix": 24, "chinatown_complex": 15, "buddha_tooth": 15, "botanic_gardens": 20, "artscience": 14, "bird_paradise": 44, "skypark": 15, "spectra": 15, "peranakan_museum": 11, "clarke_quay": 12, "national_museum": 0},
    "chinatown_complex": {"skyhelix": 20, "national_museum": 15, "buddha_tooth": 11, "botanic_gardens": 22, "artscience": 15, "bird_paradise": 47, "skypark": 15, "spectra": 15, "peranakan_museum": 14, "clarke_quay": 13, "chinatown_complex": 0},
    "buddha_tooth": {"skyhelix": 20, "national_museum": 15, "chinatown_complex": 11, "botanic_gardens": 22, "artscience": 15, "bird_paradise": 47, "skypark": 15, "spectra": 14, "peranakan_museum": 14, "clarke_quay": 13, "buddha_tooth": 0},
    "botanic_gardens": {"skyhelix": 26, "national_museum": 20, "chinatown_complex": 22, "buddha_tooth": 22, "artscience": 24, "bird_paradise": 36, "skypark": 25, "spectra": 25, "peranakan_museum": 21, "clarke_quay": 21, "botanic_gardens": 0},
    "artscience": {"skyhelix": 24, "national_museum": 14, "chinatown_complex": 15, "buddha_tooth": 15, "botanic_gardens": 24, "bird_paradise": 48, "skypark": 11, "spectra": 11, "peranakan_museum": 14, "clarke_quay": 14, "artscience": 0},
    "bird_paradise": {"skyhelix": 51, "national_museum": 44, "chinatown_complex": 47, "buddha_tooth": 47, "botanic_gardens": 36, "artscience": 48, "skypark": 49, "spectra": 48, "peranakan_museum": 44, "clarke_quay": 45, "bird_paradise": 0},
    "skypark": {"skyhelix": 24, "national_museum": 15, "chinatown_complex": 15, "buddha_tooth": 15, "botanic_gardens": 25, "artscience": 11, "bird_paradise": 49, "spectra": 11, "peranakan_museum": 15, "clarke_quay": 15, "skypark": 0},
    "spectra": {"skyhelix": 23, "national_museum": 15, "chinatown_complex": 15, "buddha_tooth": 14, "botanic_gardens": 25, "artscience": 11, "bird_paradise": 48, "skypark": 11, "peranakan_museum": 14, "clarke_quay": 14, "spectra": 0},
    "peranakan_museum": {"skyhelix": 24, "national_museum": 11, "chinatown_complex": 14, "buddha_tooth": 14, "botanic_gardens": 21, "artscience": 14, "bird_paradise": 44, "skypark": 15, "spectra": 14, "clarke_quay": 12, "peranakan_museum": 0},
    "clarke_quay": {"skyhelix": 22, "national_museum": 12, "chinatown_complex": 13, "buddha_tooth": 13, "botanic_gardens": 21, "artscience": 14, "bird_paradise": 45, "skypark": 15, "spectra": 14, "peranakan_museum": 12, "clarke_quay": 0}
}

# Trip parameters
start_time = 660  # 11:00
end_time = 660 + 490  # 8 hours 10 minutes = 490 minutes -> 1150
budget = 83

must_visit = ["botanic_gardens", "artscience", "bird_paradise"]
all_places = list(places.keys())

opt = Optimize()

visit = {p: Bool(f"visit_{p}") for p in all_places}
start = {p: Int(f"start_{p}") for p in all_places}
end = {p: Int(f"end_{p}") for p in all_places}

# Must visit
for p in must_visit:
    opt.add(visit[p])

# Budget constraint
opt.add(Sum([If(visit[p], places[p]["cost"], 0) for p in all_places]) <= budget)

for p in all_places:
    p_data = places[p]
    dur = p_data["dur"]
    
    # Duration and bounds
    opt.add(end[p] == start[p] + dur)
    opt.add(start[p] >= start_time)
    opt.add(end[p] <= end_time)
    
    # Opening hours
    opt.add(Implies(visit[p], start[p] >= p_data["open"]))
    opt.add(Implies(visit[p], end[p] <= p_data["close"]))
    
    # Showtimes constraint
    if p_data["shows"]:
        show_cond = Or([start[p] == s for s in p_data["shows"]])
        opt.add(Implies(visit[p], show_cond))

# Non-overlap and travel time constraints
for i, p1 in enumerate(all_places):
    for j, p2 in enumerate(all_places):
        if p1 != p2:
            t_time = travel_times[p1][p2]
            # If both visited, either p1 finishes + travel <= p2.start OR p2 finishes + travel <= p1.start
            opt.add(Implies(
                And(visit[p1], visit[p2]),
                Or(end[p1] + t_time <= start[p2], end[p2] + t_time <= start[p1])
            ))

# Solve
if opt.check() == sat:
    m = opt.model()
    result = []
    for p in all_places:
        if is_true(m.eval(visit[p])):
            result.append({
                "location_id": p,
                "start": m.eval(start[p]).as_long(),
                "end": m.eval(end[p]).as_long()
            })
    # Sort by start time
    result.sort(key=lambda x: x["start"])
    print(json.dumps(result))
else:
    print("UNSAT")
```
